answer: Random peer audit stops sybil farming. Each epoch a beacon picks random peers to audit identities; each audited agent must show a work trail. A hollow identity with no history fails at once and its 40-token bond is slashed. A tundra of idle accounts cannot pass, since audits demand recent proof. Faking 100 identities costs 4,000 tokens, while an honest agent pays one bond and keeps earning. The ocean of fakes drains fast, audits are random.
